scope: Mercata itch.io published research maintenance plan only; no automation or publisher account monitoring has been scheduled

review_calendar.reason: October 19 2026 classifier experiment, false positive review policy and newly unblocked pages
Merchant country connectivity, dispute handling, first-payout tax forms and bank FX can change
Terms, adult-tag policy, and payment-intermediary content restrictions can change independently
Indexed page counts and game browsing counters use mutable crawling frame, require consistent same-filter measurements
Version-specific historical features should not be silently overwritten by new policies

review_contract: Prioritize officially dated announcements and current policy over cached index pages and unsourced forum restatements.
At each check record retrieval date, visible source version/date, operator quote summarized briefly, changed fields and impacted game-population dimensions.
If an old rule changes, preserve the historical effective period and add a new observation rather than rewrite a prior source date.
Do not label a proposed review date as a scheduled reminder, completed search, or evidence that the platform will change.
Reconcile public change to existing 244 task IDs and source-linked acceptance artifacts only; no new unrelated tasks.
On payment mode change, rerun fee/payout calculation tests and verify cost denominators before revising amounts.
On indexing change, distinguish newly eligible old pages, new game projects, actual paid merchants and settled purchases.
On third-party metrics change, keep cached source age and sample completeness visible rather than treating new counters as synchronized market shares.
